headline: Committee reports, staff updates, a community plan success review, and appointments and resignations are on the agenda.
summary: The agenda lists six committee reports and updates from the Office of Early Childhood and Shine, local updates, and Parent Ambassadors. It also covers a community plan question about how success will be measured, along with resignations, appointments, and new and old business.
items: Office of Early Childhood and Shine updates
